newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower on deliveries.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower on deliveries.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Thursday after deliveries were posted against the July, pit sources said.
"There were some receipts taken off the board," a trader said. CBOT on Thursday said 16 lots of rice were posted for delivery against the July. LIT America and Lind-Waldock were the primary stoppers.
But floor sources noted trade was extremely thin, meaning small-lot orders could move the market several cents.
The trade awaited results of tenders for North and South Korea as well as for Syria.
Rice ended eight to three cents per cwt lower with September down three at $9.55. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 100 lots, against Wednesday's actual of 166.
